wake-of-gods.mapobjects.sphinxes.descrip: A mysterious guardian offering a risky trial: a blessing or curse lasting 1-7 days. Costs 1,280 movement points. One trial per hero per day.
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.sphinxes.onVisit:
{Sphinx}

The guardian has already judged you today. Return tomorrow.
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.sphinxes.onEmpty:
